purpose: Reviewed allowlist of every line by which the composed production Firestore Rules on gameplay/recovery-v1 differ from what production main deploys. The main gate must see exactly these changes and nothing else. Regenerate only with node tests/support/composed-production-rules.cjs --print-main-delta origin/main, then review every hunk.

candidate.base: main e849e0ff (r85 Rules live, unchanged since 076177e2) plus r86 career summaries (two R86-SUMMARY hunks) and r87 Roster Russian Roulette (one R87-RRR hunk: the optional signing overall). Regenerated with --print-main-delta origin/main

added: && (!('overall' in value) || (value.overall is int && value.overall >= 30 && value.overall <= 99))
hunks.why: r87 Roster Russian Roulette (Nik 2026-10-30): each own Transfer War signing may carry its FIFA 17 overall (whole number 30-99, optional key so older rows stay valid); it decides the roulette board from season 2. No new path, read or write.

added: // r86 reads at scale (Nik 2026-10-27): one create-only career summary per finished Showdown under the reading
// account. Reads are owner-only exact gets (no lookup); the one create checks the closed root and, for a completed
// Showdown, that the summary's totals, winner and length equal the Terminal Close witness. Never updated or deleted.
hunks.why: r86 reads at scale: one create-only career summary per finished Showdown, checked against the closed root (completed totals, winner and length equal the Terminal Close witness; abandoned and never-started carry no totals).

added: // A disabled or tombstoned account loses its summaries with the rest of the shared history (same boundary as
allow get: if signedIn() && request.auth.uid == accountId && activeAccount(request.auth.uid);
allow update, list, delete: if false;
hunks.why: r86 reads at scale: owner-only exact get of accounts/{uid}/careerSummary/{rivalryId}; one create; never updated, listed or deleted. Both get and create require an active account, like the completed-history grants.
